notes: Storm Thunderhead strike: a bolt drops from above the frame onto the ground point, which it hits on frame 2; ground flash, crackling 3:2 ring, scorch star, sparks, fading glow. Play once at the end of the cast's wind-up (the game keeps its ring + timer). 48x96, 20 fps, shown at 1x. Anchor = strike point on the ground. Apollo.
